verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents actual rate limits (requests or tokens per minute) or how they scale across tiers. The only related items are a marketing line, 'Free tier*, higher limits on demand', which says limits exist but not what they are, and model pages listing price per service tier, which covers pricing rather than rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production
